# Workloads allowed to carry a spelling the portability class refuses.
#
# `<class> <spelling>` per line, matched by CLASS AND SPELLING and NEVER by line: a
# line-matched list turns dev red the first time an edit above it shifts a line, which is
# SPEC-CI's shared convention.
#
# It is SHRINK-ONLY. Nothing is added here without the reason on the line beside it, and an
# entry nothing matches is a failure, not a comment.
#
# It is empty.
